source_reviews.independent_solution: Incoming steel-ball kinetic energy temporarily becomes elastic potential energy during ball/plate deformation; recovery converts stored elastic energy back into motion. Real contact may also transfer energy into sound, internal energy or plate vibration, and rebound alone does not imply perfect return. In an explicitly lossless contact model with negligible height change the mechanical chain is kinetic -> elastic potential -> kinetic.

source_reviews.independent_solution: With common zero plane, mass, field and height, U=mgh is the same. K=mv^2/2 still depends on speed. Both are compatible with the missing initial data, so kinetic energies are not necessarily equal and not necessarily unequal.
